Building automation (BMS / BAS)

Run the whole building from one screen, with HVAC, chiller plant, tenant overrides and garage air monitored and tuned automatically. The anchor system: everything else connects to it.

Building automation in detail

  • Lighting and shading control (Lutron)

    Rooms that light themselves for the time of day, cut glare and meet energy code without anyone touching a switch. Homes, offices, hotels and storefronts, with motorized shades on the same system.

    • Lutron

  • Home and commercial automation (Crestron)

    One touch sets the room: lights, climate, shades, security and audio-video together, at home or in the boardroom. The interface layer that makes every other system feel like one.

    • Crestron

  • Access control and video (ACS / CCTV)

    Know who is in the building, control where they can go, and see every entrance from one video wall or one phone. Credentials, elevator access, cameras, plate recognition and intrusion on one platform.

    • ACS
    • CCTV
    • Intrusion

  • Energy monitoring and analytics

    See where the energy goes, bill tenants for what they use, and catch faults before the utility bill does. Metering, dashboards, fault detection and verified conservation projects.

    • Metering
    • Sub-metering

  • Indoor air quality

    Keep CO2, humidity and ventilation where a healthy building needs them, with the records to prove it. Demand-control ventilation, humidity sequences and garage exhaust from the same platform.

    • CO2
    • NO2
    • Demand-control ventilation

  • Service and support

    Preventive maintenance, 24/7 emergency response and remote monitoring, so the system you paid for keeps doing its job. Written agreements, training, help desk and design-build with your engineers.

    • 24/7
    • Remote monitoring
